dialogue.text: Wait—clouds are water vapor! Why is Apple charging me money for water?

dialogue.speaker: claude
dialogue.text: [sigh] It is remote hard drives in a data center, not actual rain clouds.

dialogue.speaker: dad
dialogue.text: Seriously? I have twenty pen drives in the kitchen cupboard right now!

dialogue.text: Look at step one: cloud storage bills you every single month forever.

dialogue.speaker: dad
dialogue.text: Bro... that password has protected our family photos since 2008!

dialogue.speaker: claude
